standard_prerequisites.name: Generic points of a decent space under an etale cover
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies generic points of the affine etale cover U = Spec(B) with those of |X|.

standard_prerequisites.name: Generically finite morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a nonzero f in A with A_f -> B_f finite after localizing at the minimal primes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dimension formula for finitely generated algebras
standard_prerequisites.use: Bounds dim(B_q) by dim(A) for a prime q over m.

core_obligations: Reduce conditions (1), (2), (3) to condition (4) and work under (4): X decent with generic fibres the generic points of irreducible components.
Choose an affine etale cover U = Spec(B) -> X; the ring map A -> B is of finite type, and the fibre over (0) is the finite set of minimal primes q_1, ..., q_r of B.
Apply generically-finite to get f nonzero in A with A_f -> B_f finite, so each kappa(q_i) is a finite extension of the fraction field of A.

For a prime q of B over m use the dimension formula to get dim(B_q) <= dim(A), and observe the minimal primes q_i are not in V(m), so the local rings of the special fibre have dimension at most dim(A) - 1; conclude with the dimension lemma for localizations.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the decent case; etale affine cover; generically finite localization; dimension formula upper bound; one-codimension drop at minimal primes.
difficulty_reason: A dimension-formula sandwich whose substantive steps are the generically-finite localization construction and the observation that minimal primes stay out of V(m), forcing the drop by one.
